expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (!b) return 'no button'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ''; return 'dashboardLive=' + (t.includes('Live') || t.includes('Modules')) + ';shell=' + t.includes('AI Controller'); })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ''; const score = document.querySelector('.text-4xl'); return JSON.stringify({ score: score ? score.textContent : null, label: (t.includes('Degraded') ? 'Degraded' : t.includes('Healthy') ? 'Healthy' : 'other'), namesDarkSite: t.includes('dark-site'), actions: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('li')).filter(li => li.querySelector('code')).map(li => li.querySelector('code').textContent) }); })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ''; return 'sampleTaskVisible=' + t.includes('Client demo: agentic engine sample') + ';completedBadge=' + (t.includes('completed') || t.includes('Completed')); })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ''; return 'edgeUp=' + t.includes('edge-sim') + ';darkDown=' + t.includes('dark-site') + ';downBadge=' + (t.match(/DOWN/g)||[]).length + ';upBadge=' + (t.match(/UP/g)||[]).length; })()
